liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (5 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer calls this performance their favorite from the 1973-74 period; Clarifies the song is the third longest known, lasting 43 minutes 28 seconds [3][13][14][18][21][22]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Describes the song as spacy, with Keith moving from piano to keyboards; Identified as the longest and best version in the reviewer's opinion [3][15][16]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): The jam into Stella Blue is called unreal, finishing with Sugar Magnolia [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Know You Rider**: cut on the recording [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-06.166462.aud.cubbedge.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 186 min [1]
- **gd1973-12-06.147505.sbd.pc.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]
- **gd73-12-06.sbd.kaplan-fink-hamilton.4452.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 184 min; rated 4.45/5 by 58 [5]. Said about its sound: Describes the recording as having great sound quality; Notes Jerry's distortion during Loser, though overall sound quality is rated A+ [19][20]
- **gd1973-12-06.132361.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 201 min; rated 4.25/5 by 12 [3]

## Around the show

- Donna Jean Godchaux was missing due to maternity leave, but the band performed well [21]
- Donna Jean Godchaux was absent due to maternity leave that night [1]
- Suggests this show should have been released instead of the December 19th show [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-06.166462.aud.cubbedge.flac16**: taped by Dave Cubbedge; source: Recorded by Dave Cubbedge on a Sony portable stereo recorder with a stereo mic. [1]. Also: First-generation copy made in the 1980s from lost 120-minute cassettes [1]
- **gd1973-12-06.147505.sbd.pc.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat [2]. Also: Pitch-corrected version of shnid=132361, with input from Rob Bertrando and Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd73-12-06.sbd.kaplan-fink-hamilton.4452.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard with Audience Patches [5]
- **gd1973-12-06.132361.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [3]
